summary.decision_summary: Sigma Chi Whiteout won by 58.3. Sigma Chi Whiteout left 11.8 lineup points on the table, while Pat Pidgeon left 14.5.
summary.historical_summary: Sigma Chi Whiteout is 19-20 against Pat Pidgeon across 39 meetings between these managers.
summary.ideal_summary: Ideal lineups still favor Sigma Chi Whiteout
summary.winner_reason: Sigma Chi Whiteout won by 58.3, led by a 33.4-point edge at QB. The leading starters were Drake Maye (46.0) and Parker Washington (27.8).
summary.loser_reason: Pat Pidgeon could not match the opponent's QB production, losing that position battle by 33.4 points. Dalton Kincaid scored 2.7. A best legal lineup added 14.5, still short of the 58.3-point margin.
